title: Not fluffy at all
text:
Not fluffy at all. I waited too long to return it...its "just okay".
It is not fluffy, even REMOTELY like a real duvet.

product_metadata.title: HARBOREST Queen Size Comforter - Down Alternative Comforter All-Season Lightweight Duvet Insert with 8 Corner Tabs (White)
features: 【Ultra Soft Touch & Noiseless】 The cover of bedding comforter with 100% brushed fiber, premium fabric made by peach-skin processing technology, make the comforter ultra soft and more breathable. It not only ensures extraordinary skin-friendly touch, but also No rustle when you sleep, provides a quite sleeping environment.

【All-season Thermal Ability 】7D whole-piece down alternative microfiber filling, light-weight but fluffy like cloud, warm filling can meet your needs in all seasons. Perfect choice for those who can't use goose down and feather bedding.

【Box Stitching & Corner Tabs】The box stitching design ensures filling evenly and prevents any leaking, shifting and clumping, thus keeping comfortable all night. The 8 durable corner tabs are convenient for keeping in place inside the duvet cover, never slide around. Can be used as a comforter alone or as a duvet insert to match your favorite duvet cover.

【Machine Washable & Easy Care】 Machine wash in the gentle cycle with cold water.Sun-dry or tumble dry on low. No shrinkage or fade which saves you a lot of time and energy. Tips: Our down alternative comforter is vacuum packaged, it will fluffy up nicely after airing it for a few hours or putting it into dryer for 15-20 mins.

【Excellent Customer Service】This all season comforter is a good gift choice to show your care on your loved ones. If any quality issue occurs, please don’t hesitate to turn to our customer service for help, we will spare no effort to help you solve the problem.
